content:
Last month we wrote about VIEWE’s ESP32-S31 4.3-inch touch display, but there’s now another option, namely the Waveshare ESP32-S31-Touch-LCD-4.3C development kit. Both models are similar, with an ESP32-S31 module equipped with 16MB flash and 16MB PSRAM, a 4.3-inch 800×480  touchscreen display, RS485 and CAN Bus interfaces, and more. The EVIEW model supports 16.7M colors, while the Waveshare devkit is limited to 65K colors, but it offers a wider 7V-36V voltage input, an optional DIN rail enclosure, and 3.7V Lithium battery support. Waveshare ESP32-S31-Touch-LCD-4.3C specifications: Wireless module – ESP32-S31-WROOM-3-N16R16V SoC – ESP32-S31NRV16 CPU RISC-V HP (High-performance) RV32IMAFCP CPU @ 320 MHz with FPU, SIMD, etc. RISC-V LP (Low-power) MCU core Memory – 512 KB SRAM, 32 KB low-power SRAM, 16MB PSRAM Wireless – 2.4 GHz WiFi 6 (802.11ax) Bluetooth 5.4 with support for LE Audio, direction finding, Bluetooth Mesh 1.1, and Classic (BR/EDR) 802.15.4 radio for Zigbee, Thread, and Matter Storage [...]
